description: This file implements a service to retrieve and aggregate LLM cost metrics by agent name from a MongoDB collection. It includes functions to resolve collection names from environment variables, build aggregation pipelines for different data schemas, fallback in-memory aggregation, and main exported functions to fetch and process LLM cost data.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Determines collection name candidates based on environment variable LLM_EVENTS_COLLECTION with default fallbacks, ensuring no duplicates and prioritizing specific collection names.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for flat schema documents to normalize agent fields and cost fields, aggregate costs by agent case-insensitively, and sort results descending by total cost.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline for documents where agents are stored as an array, normalizing agent names and costs, and aggregating costs per agent case-insensitively.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: In-memory aggregation function used as fallback; processes an array of documents to sum costs by agent, preserving display casing, and rounding to 6 decimal places.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main exported async function that attempts multi-version MongoDB aggregation pipelines to retrieve LLM costs by agent from the database, with fallback to in-process aggregation if pipelines fail or produce no results.
